parsedVerdict.reasoning: All four files deal with one concern: application use cases for the User aggregate. Each use case has a port interface (CreateUserUseCase, ListUsersUseCase) and a service that implements it (CreateUserService, ListUsersService). Both services follow the same pattern. They depend on the domain UserRepository abstraction and map results through the shared toUserDto mapper, so the DTO mapping lives in one place. User creation goes through the domain factory User.create, and id generation goes through the IdGenerator port, so neither service skips the module's abstractions or copies a domain invariant. The rule is not repeated across files.
